chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said: “My life is good for you, and my death is good for you.” They said: “O Messenger of Allah, how is that?” So he, peace be upon him and his family, said:
“As for my life, indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, says:
“And Allah would not punish them while you are among them.”
“And as for my separation from you, your deeds are presented to me every day. So whatever is good, I ask Allah to increase it for you, and whatever is evil, I seek Allah’s forgiveness for you.”

They said: “Even when you have decayed, O Messenger of Allah?”—meaning, when you have become dust. He said: “No. Indeed Allah, Blessed and Exalted, has forbidden the earth to consume anything of our flesh.”

key_terms.أَعْمَالَكُمْ: Your deeds; the actions of the believers that are presented to the Prophet.
key_terms.اِسْتَغْفَرْتُ: I sought forgiveness; the Prophet’s asking Allah to forgive the believers.
key_terms.حَيَاتِي: My life; the Prophet’s worldly presence as a source of good for the community.
key_terms.رَمِيماً: Dust or decayed remains; referring to bodily decomposition.
key_terms.لُحُومَنَا: Our flesh; referring to the bodies of the Prophet and those included with him in this statement.
key_terms.مَمَاتِي: My death; the Prophet’s posthumous state that still brings benefit to the believers.
key_terms.مُفَارَقَتِي: My separation; referring to the Prophet’s departure from the community through death.

ai.seo_question: How are the life and death of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله both a mercy for the community?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the presence of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله keeps punishment away from the community, as affirmed by the Qur'an. It also teaches that after his departure, the deeds of the community are presented to him, and he responds with du'a for their good and seeking forgiveness for their wrongs. The report further affirms the special sanctity of the bodies of the Prophet and his family.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.582 - The Prophet, said: "My life is good for you, and my death is good for you."
They asked: "O’ Messenger of Allah (sw), how is that?"
He (sw) said: "As for my life, Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, says:
'And Allah (swt) would not punish them while you are among them' (Surah Al-Anfal 8:33)
As for my separation from you (in death), your deeds are presented to me every day; whatever I find of good, I increase my supplication to Allah (swt) for you, and whatever I find of bad, I seek forgiveness from Allah (swt) for you."
They said: "Even after you have become dust (in your grave), O’ Messenger of Allah (sw)?"
He (sw) replied: "No! Verily, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, has forbidden the earth from consuming our flesh”.
